v31_loot.description: CYC4-014. Places a dungeon-loot chest and a plain chest beside the caller, inspects both, then reads the loot chest's NBT. Expect INVENTORY_INSPECT lootRolled=false lootTable=minecraft:chests/simple_dungeon with no occupiedSlots; then NBT still carrying LootTable and no Items; then the plain chest with occupiedSlots=1. Setting the chests to air clears them first, so nothing drops; the kill is a safety net. It first clears both spots to air, tolerating air already there, so a rerun after a stopped run starts from fresh chests.
